# Harpies
## General Information
Harpies are light, winged humanoids. They [color=lightgreen]run 10% faster[/color] than humans and have [color=lightgreen]better acceleration in zero-gravity environments[/color]. With both wings free (empty hands, not restrained) they can [color=lightgreen]fly for a short time[/color], moving faster and over obstacles at a heavy stamina cost.
Their unarmed attacks use talons that deal [color=lightgreen]5 Piercing damage[/color].
They can [color=lightgreen]mimic almost any sound[/color] through emotes, and have an innate instrument they can sing with. Singing stops when they are muted, crit, shoved down or take more than 5 damage at once.
## Drawbacks
Their avian lungs [color=palevioletred]use up air tanks twice as fast[/color], and they [color=palevioletred]start choking on carbon dioxide and ammonia[/color]. Breathing pure oxygen for a few seconds or leaving the fumes stops the choking.
Their hollow bones make them take [color=palevioletred]15% more Brute damage[/color].
Being so light, they are [color=palevioletred]easy to shove down, pick up and throw[/color], get more recoil from guns and struggle to drag heavy objects.
Their eyes see ultraviolet light, but they [color=palevioletred]cannot see the color red[/color].
